incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#INC-5421 — host/gpu-12a3 (us-west-2b) reporting KubeletNotReady; multiple pods in prod scheduled on this node are in CrashLoopBackOff. link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-5421

pagerduty: Alert details — Severity: P1, Service: inference-serving, Impact: degraded latency for route /v1/generate (partial fallback to other nodes). Pager on-call: karen_oncall.

karen_oncall: On it. ACKing and joining. Can someone pull node status and dmesg?

sre_jordan: I ran `kubectl get nodes gpu-12a3 -o wide` — Node Ready: False, STATUS: NotReady. `kubectl describe node gpu-12a3` shows "KubeletNotReady: Kubelet stopped posting node status". 

sre_jordan: Quick paste of conditions:
```
Conditions:
  Type             Status  Reason                     Message
  ----             ------  ------                     -------
  Ready            False   KubeletNotReady            kubelet stopped posting status
  MemoryPressure   False   KubeletHasSufficientMemory
  DiskPressure     False   KubeletHasSufficientDisk
```

devops_olga: I'm seeing repeated kernel oops in the host syslog. snippet from `journalctl -k -n 50`:
```
[    42.123456] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, pid=12345, GPU has fallen off the bus
[    42.123789] kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000008
[    42.124000] kernel: panic: Fatal exception in interrupt
```

ml_eng_lee: That Xid 31 usually indicates a device/driver hang on the NVIDIA card. Might be hardware or driver. Was this node recently patched?

devops_olga: No kernel updates in the last 72h. But GPU driver v530 has been in use since last month. I can try to SSH in, but node is not responding to SSH — console unreachable.

karen_oncall: Paging SRE lead @sre_jordan for escalation, and tagging infra-owner @devops_olga. Marking impact: some requests are being routed away but we have observed a 15-25% latency/regression on the generation fleet. Customer Success: any high-impact customers on that node?

customer_success_ana: Search indexing tenant "AcmeCorp" saw errors and token billing spikes; CS is sending a heads up to their CTO. We'll open a bridge if this stays >10min.

sre_jordan: Plan: 1) Cordon node (if kubelet accepts) 2) Force drain with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` 3) If node unreachable, remove from LB and reprovision host via infra automation 4) Postmortem & rollback driver if needed.

karen_oncall: Trying cordon:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-12a3
Error from server: node "gpu-12a3" not found
```

sre_jordan: That indicates control plane lost node record — kubelet stopped heartbeating and apiserver removed recent registration. Run `kubectl get pods -A --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-12a3` to see which pods remain scheduled and need emergency eviction.

devops_olga: Running from control plane host now. Pods still bound in etcd but kubelet unreachable. I'm executing infra automation to mark host as FAILED and provision replacement. Command: `infractl host mark-failed --host gpu-12a3 --reason kernel_panic` (started).

ml_eng_lee: Suggest we scale up spare capacity for the inference pool to reduce throttling while we reprovision. I'll bump replica counts on the deployment for route /v1/generate by +2.

karen_oncall: Done. Noted: increased replicas on infer-* deployments. Monitoring: latency downward trend starting.

pagerduty: karen_oncall acknowledged the incident at 1768854330. Escalation to SRE lead at 1768854375.

devops_olga: Infra automation reports host gpu-12a3 marked FAILED and reprovision job started (AMI rollback to last-known-good + reattach drivers). ETA 14 minutes.

sre_jordan: Forensics: pulled last serial console lines — kernel panic message: "Kernel panic - not syncing: GPU driver NVRM aborting" — looks like driver/hardware. We'll capture machine for further analysis.

customer_success_ana: AcmeCorp is on the bridge and appreciates the update. They've requested postmortem and mitigation timeline.

karen_oncall: I'll stay on this incident until handoff at T+45. Next on-call is devops_olga, please prepare to take over at 1768854721.

devops_olga: Will take handoff. I also opened a ticket with cloud-provider support for possible host replacement warranty.

sre_jordan: Mitigation complete: replacement host assigned, pods rescheduled, autoscaling absorbed load. Observability: error rate for /v1/generate returned to baseline at 1768854610.

karen_oncall: Closing PagerDuty incident as mitigated, will keep bridge open for postmortem notes. PD incident closed by karen_oncall at 1768854665.

customer_success_ana: I'll send a status update and ETA for postmortem to AcmeCorp.

karen_oncall: Postmortem owners: devops_olga (driver/infra), sre_jordan (kubelet/cluster), ml_eng_lee (service-level fallback). Tagging for follow-up. :white_check_mark:

devops_olga: collecting syslogs and serial console dump for upload to S3 -> s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-5421/

sre_jordan: Leaving final note: if we see recurrence with driver v530, schedule rollback to v525 in a canary pool.

karen_oncall: handoff: devops_olga now assuming on-call at 1768854721. Leaving channel. :wave:

devops_olga: Acknowledged.
